context: Interactive data visualization — a WebGL-accelerated radial edge-bundled dependency network with a D3 SVG overlay for nodes, labels, and hover interaction
first_impression: A clean ring of color-coded nodes with polished chrome (controls, legend, info bar), but the edge bundles — the entire point of the visualization — are completely invisible in the default state
what_works: Deliberate use of Paul Tol's colorblind-safe 'bright' palette rather than schemeCategory10 shows genuine design intention; typographic hierarchy is clear with a bold 17px title, muted 12px subtitle, and quiet 12px legend
what_doesnt: The primary visual encoding (edge bundles) is invisible at rest — max alpha of ~0.34 at 1.4px line width renders 829 edges as nothing, making the visualization look like an unfinished ring of dots rather than a network; node labels at 6.5px opacity 0.55 are too small and faint to read without hovering, leaving the interior of the chart completely empty and purposeless until interaction
